name: Billboard Nana
description: Iconic third-floor entertainment venue in Nana Plaza featuring a famous rotating central stage, jacuzzi centerpiece, and high-octane neon nightlife energy.

sponsor_data.promo_text: Located on the 3rd floor of Nana Plaza, Sukhumvit Soi 4. Bangkok's most famous multi-tiered entertainment complex.

transit_tip: Take BTS Sukhumvit Line to Nana Station (Exit 2). Walk 150m south down Sukhumvit Soi 4 into the Nana Plaza atrium.
opening_hours: 8:00 PM – 2:00 AM daily • Peak Vibe: 10:30 PM – 1:30 AM

name: Spanky's Nana
description: High-energy entertainment club on the 2nd floor of Nana Plaza known for playful stage performances, costume themes, and vibrant international crowds.
transit_tip: BTS Nana Station (Exit 2), 2 minutes walk into Nana Plaza, 2nd floor balcony corridor.
opening_hours: 7:30 PM – 2:00 AM daily

name: Hillary 2 Bar & Live Music
description: Bustling open-front sports and live rock music bar situated right in the center of Sukhumvit Soi 4 directly opposite Nana Plaza. Premier people-watching patio.
transit_tip: BTS Nana Station (Exit 2). Stroll 80 meters down Soi 4 on the left hand side.
opening_hours: 1:00 PM – 2:00 AM daily • Live Bands from 8:30 PM

name: Rainbow 4
description: Popular ground floor venue in the Nana Plaza complex featuring modern LED sound, lively service, and central courtyard views.
transit_tip: BTS Nana, Nana Plaza ground floor courtyard.
opening_hours: 8:00 PM – 2:00 AM daily

name: Baccara
description: The world-famous neon beacon anchoring the eastern corner of Soi Cowboy. Legendary two-story glass dance floor with pulsating techno beats and glowing neon.

sponsor_data.promo_text: Anchoring the Sukhumvit Soi 23 end of Soi Cowboy. World-renowned 2-floor neon architecture.

transit_tip: BTS Asok (Exit 3) or MRT Sukhumvit (Exit 2). Walk 100m into Soi Cowboy; Baccara is the glowing corner at the far end.
opening_hours: 7:00 PM – 2:00 AM daily • Peak Vibe: 10:00 PM – 1:30 AM

name: Crazy House
description: One of Soi Cowboy's most visually distinctive split-level venues with open mezzanine walkways, glass floors, and nonstop energy.
transit_tip: BTS Asok or MRT Sukhumvit. Midway along Soi Cowboy corridor.
opening_hours: 7:30 PM – 2:00 AM daily

name: Suzie Wong
description: Chinese-lantern themed lounge with classic red velvet decor, retro Hong Kong ambiance, and friendly hospitable atmosphere along Soi Cowboy.
transit_tip: BTS Asok (Exit 3), 1 minute walk into Soi Cowboy entrance.
opening_hours: 7:00 PM – 2:00 AM daily

name: Levels Club & Lounge
description: Bangkok's premier upscale international nightclub on the 6th floor of Aloft Hotel. Features an open-air terrace lounge, massive chandelier ballroom, and international guest DJs.

sponsor_data.promo_text: Sukhumvit Soi 11 at Aloft Bangkok. VIP table reservations, bottle service, and world-class sound.

transit_tip: BTS Nana (Exit 3). Walk 300m down Sukhumvit Soi 11 to Aloft Hotel, take elevator to 6th floor.
opening_hours: 9:00 PM – 3:00 AM Wed–Sun • Peak: 11:30 PM

name: Oskar Bistro
description: Trendy, chic French-Mediterranean gastro-lounge with stylish curbside dining that transforms into a buzzing DJ party bar every night of the week.
transit_tip: BTS Nana Station (Exit 3), 4 minutes walk into Sukhumvit Soi 11.
opening_hours: 5:00 PM – 2:00 AM daily • Dining & Cocktails

name: Above Eleven Rooftop
description: Spectacular 33rd-floor rooftop bar and Peruvian-Japanese (Nikkei) restaurant overlooking the downtown skyline with Central Park-inspired tree architecture.
transit_tip: BTS Nana (Exit 3), Fraser Suites Sukhumvit Soi 11, 33rd floor.
opening_hours: 6:00 PM – 2:00 AM daily • Sunset Views & Cocktails

name: The Club Khaosan
description: The crown jewel mega-club of Khaosan Road featuring massive festival-grade lasers, CO2 cannons, heavy bass EDM sound systems, and a cavernous dance floor.

sponsor_data.promo_text: Heart of Khaosan Road. High-octane lasers, international guest artists, and packed dance floors.

transit_tip: MRT Sanam Chai or Sam Yot (10 min taxi/tuk-tuk), or Chao Phraya Express Boat to Phra Arthit Pier (N13) and walk 8 minutes.
opening_hours: 9:00 PM – 2:30 AM daily • Peak: Midnight

name: Brick Bar
description: Legendary basement ska, reggae, and Thai indie live music institution in the basement of Buddy Lodge Hotel on Khaosan Road.
transit_tip: Phra Arthit Pier (N13) or Sanam Chai MRT, Buddy Lodge basement.
opening_hours: 8:00 PM – 2:00 AM daily

name: Route 66 Club
description: Thailand's most famous clubbing institution spanning multiple sprawling rooms: Live Band Hall, Hip Hop Arena, and EDM Zone. The epic ground zero for Songkran water festivals.

sponsor_data.promo_text: Royal City Avenue (RCA). 3 massive musical zones: Live Thai bands, Hip-Hop, and International EDM.

transit_tip: MRT Phetchaburi or Phra Ram 9 (Exit 2). 5 minutes motorcycle taxi / Grab to RCA Block A.
opening_hours: 8:00 PM – 2:00 AM daily • 3 Massive Music Zones

name: Onyx Bangkok
description: Mainstage festival-style superclub ranked among DJ Mag's Top 100 Clubs in the world. Colossal 50-foot LED wall, stadium lasers, and world-class EDM headliners.
transit_tip: MRT Phra Ram 9 or Phetchaburi, RCA Strip Block B.
opening_hours: 9:00 PM – 2:30 AM Wed–Sun

name: The Stranger Bar & House of Drag
description: Southeast Asia's world-famous House of Drag Queen Bar located at the head of Silom Soi 4. Outstanding live drag productions, signature cocktails, and electric party energy.

sponsor_data.promo_text: Silom Soi 4. World-renowned drag shows, signature craft cocktails, and high-energy vibes.

transit_tip: BTS Sala Daeng (Exit 1) or MRT Silom (Exit 2). 2 minutes walk into pedestrianized Silom Soi 4.
opening_hours: 7:00 PM – 2:00 AM daily • Shows at 10:30 PM & Midnight

name: Telephone Pub & Restaurant
description: Historic open-air dining terrace and lively cocktail bar operating since the 1980s in the center of Silom Soi 4. Unrivaled people-watching street patio.
transit_tip: BTS Sala Daeng (Exit 1), halfway down Silom Soi 4.
opening_hours: 6:00 PM – 2:00 AM daily • Patio Dining & Karaoke Lounge

name: Beam Club Bangkok
description: Minimalist industrial warehouse underground club inside 72 Courtyard Thonglor featuring an acoustic body-kinetic dance floor and cutting-edge deep house/techno artists.
transit_tip: BTS Thong Lo (Exit 3). Motorcycle taxi 2 minutes up Sukhumvit 55 to 72 Courtyard.
opening_hours: 9:00 PM – 2:00 AM Wed–Sat

name: T-One Sky Bar (Tichuca Rooftop)
description: Spectacular tiki-themed jungle sky bar on the 46th floor of T-One Building known for its colossal glowing LED jellyfish tree and 360-degree panorama of Bangkok.
transit_tip: BTS Thong Lo (Exit 4) via direct skybridge into T-One Building.
opening_hours: 5:00 PM – 1:00 AM daily • Sunset Panoramic Drinks

name: Teens of Thailand (ToT)
description: Pioneering gin-centric speakeasy bar concealed behind historic wooden doors on Chinatown's trendy Soi Nana, named among Asia's 50 Best Bars.
transit_tip: MRT Hua Lamphong (Exit 2) or MRT Wat Mangkon (Exit 1). Walk 6 minutes into Soi Nana (Chinatown).
opening_hours: 7:00 PM – 1:00 AM daily • Craft Gin Infusions

name: Tep Bar Cultural Lounge
description: Hip cultural drinking den inside a restored Chinatown shophouse serving traditional Thai herbal spirits (ya dong) with electrifying live classical Thai xylophone and percussion.
transit_tip: MRT Hua Lamphong (Exit 2) or Wat Mangkon, alleyway off Soi Nana Chinatown.
opening_hours: 6:00 PM – 1:00 AM daily • Live Thai Music from 8:00 PM
